name: Sega System 16B audio section
drawing: Audio section of the System 16B CPU board schematic, which this site does not hold -- via MAME's netlist
revision: Sega System 16B CPU board, audio: the YM3012 DAC's two channels and the uPD7759 speech through TL084 and LM324 filters to the mixer and preamplifier.
coverage: 2 ICs, 29 other parts and 25 nets over 77 pins. Converted from MAME's netlist, up to the power amplifier's input. The YM2151/YM3012 and uPD7759 are MAME devices; their outputs are ports. Not compared with a sheet: it is MAME's reading as MAME has it, and the notes say why. The board view carries the ICs and the nets between them; the board numbers its ICs rather than naming positions, so they are laid out in designator order, not where they sit.

origin.sourceLabel: The conversion, every change from MAME's file logged
origin.what: The netlist is MAME's -- written to simulate this board, from its schematics -- converted here into the board's own nets, with MAME's simulation stand-ins undone and, where this site holds the schematic, checked and corrected against it. The board view, chip lookup and bill of materials are made from it.
